conflict.setting: shabby hallway of a rented flat, an open door, a suitcase by the wall
conflict.action: The capybara with a suitcase holds out a paw for the deposit. The goose blocks the doorway, jabs a wing at a tiny scuff on the wallpaper, hisses and flaps her wings. At the end the capybara calmly takes out a phone.

lines.text: Обои потёрли! Залог мой, весь до копейки!

punchline.setting: shabby hallway of a rented flat, an open door, a suitcase by the wall
punchline.action: The capybara calmly holds the phone up towards the goose like a document. The goose freezes, her feathers stand on end, the bunch of keys drops from her wing, then she slowly lowers her wings.

lines.text: Три года — это нормальный износ. Залог верните.
